text: hi te gahapati sikkhitabbanti . [2] atha kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā sārīputto etadavoca vippasannāni 1 kho te gahapati indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto alattha no ajja bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti . kiñhi 2 no
